column1: # Slovene (sl) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_sl` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1, 101 ...) | two (2, 102 ...) | few (3, 4, 103 ...) | other.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Slovene computing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI

# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
